arraial.guia.0:
§lArraial Guide§r

How to found, grow, feed and protect your village.

Turn the page.
arraial.guia.1:
§lFounding§r

Place the Cruzeiro: it founds the village (48 block reach).

Each free bed draws a newcomer. Build a Storehouse: it holds the stock and everyone's food.
arraial.guia.2:
§lVillagers§r

Each eats 1 food a day from the Storehouse. Hungry ones do not work, and after 3 days they leave.

Click a villager to talk; with food in hand, you feed them.
arraial.guia.3:
§lTrades (1)§r
Villagers without a trade take a free post:

Chopping block: woodcutter
Basket: farmer
Kiln: potter
Clay tub: clay digger
Bench: quarryman
Trough: herder
arraial.guia.4:
§lTrades (2)§r

Guard post: soldier
Flour oven: flour maker
Market stall: seller
Pack saddle: muleteer
Apothecary counter: apothecary
arraial.guia.5:
§lTrades (3)§r

Fish trap: fisher
Hunting rack: hunter
Drafting board: engineer
Writing desk: public relations

Builders come by Contract. Sneak with an empty hand to dismiss a villager from a trade.
arraial.guia.6:
§lBuilding§r

Place a Site Marker and pick the project with the Book of Projects. Builders take materials from the Storehouse.

Sneak on the Marker, empty hand: change priority.
arraial.guia.7:
§lMayor§r

With 4 villagers, the eldest becomes mayor and orders buildings on their own.

With a Town Hall, they govern from there. If the people lose faith, there is a new election.
arraial.guia.8:
§lFood§r

Fields: wheat becomes bread.
Cassava: the flour maker makes flour (yields more).
Fisher and herder help.
The hunter never takes pen animals, tame ones, horses or named ones.
arraial.guia.9:
§lSafety§r

At night monsters attack villagers. Soldiers (Watchtower) defend and escort.

The Stockade surrounds the village with gates. The engineer's lamp posts light the streets.
arraial.guia.10:
§lCrises (1)§r

Drought: a well saves the fields.
Flood: only in storms.
Plague: chickens eat the caterpillars.
Bandits: raid the Storehouse at night; killing them returns the loot.
arraial.guia.11:
§lCrises (2)§r

Epidemic: the apothecary cures with remedies.
Fire: everyone runs with a bucket.

Each morning the mayor orders repairs of what fell.
arraial.guia.12:
§lMarket and réis§r

Prices rise with scarcity and fall with plenty.

At the Stall (by day, with the seller): réis in hand buys; goods in hand sells. High reputation gives a discount.
arraial.guia.13:
§lOther villages§r

Exploring far away, you find hamlets that grow on their own.

The muleteer takes the surplus and brings what is missing. On the road, the troop can be robbed.
arraial.guia.14:
§lPublic relations§r

Visits the neighbours.
Allies (reputation 50+) send food in crises.
Enemies (-50) may send bandits.
Helping a neighbour in a crisis builds strong friendship.
arraial.guia.15:
§lStages§r

Hamlet
Arraial: 6 villagers, storehouse, well
Town: 14, town hall, market
Prosperous town: 24, apothecary, stockade
City: 40, muleteer's shelter, satisfaction 60
arraial.guia.16:
§lSatisfaction§r

Rises with food, homes, health, safety and services; falls with crises.

Too low: people leave.
Very high: newcomers arrive faster.
arraial.guia.17:
§lTips§r

Click the Cruzeiro: report.
Sneaking: chronicle.
With a book: a copy of the chronicle.

arraial.guia.18:
§lCalendar and festas§r

The year has 12 months of 2 days. April to October: dry season. November to March: rainy season.

Saint John: June 2.
Patron saint: one month per village.
Great Fair: March and September 1.

Food and Festa Flags make a better festa.
